name: Andre Gerecke
title: Senior Digital Transformation Manager
profile: Digital transformation professional with 16+ years of experience and functional AI leadership in renewables. I shape AI transformation at OPEA, supporting adoption across business functions from use-case ideation and experimentation through implementation, scaling and impact tracking. I developed an AI Prompting Framework and build capability through hands-on workshops, Copilot enablement and coaching. With business, IT/OT and technology partners, I turn opportunities into solutions aligned with enterprise architecture and operational needs.
competencies: AI strategy translation and scaling: business-led use cases, adoption and measurable impact
Innovation and experimentation: ideation, proof of concept, rapid iteration and validation
AI enablement portfolio and delivery: hands-on workshops, rapid prototyping and hackathons
Business-led delivery: persona implementations, benefit tracking and operational integration
Digital transformation and agile project management: Scrum, Design Thinking and Lean Startup
Cross-functional collaboration, workshop facilitation and coaching: business, IT/OT and delivery teams

bullets: Conceived the OPEA AI Strategy 2026 and supporting AI enablement portfolio, defining a structured approach to scaling AI adoption and connecting practical capability building with business-value creation.

Shaped AI-centred business-process redesign through Design Thinking-inspired workshops with Development EU, Engineering and Operations, contributing to NPV.OptimAIzer, an AI lighthouse integrating turbine selection, layout optimisation, wind-resource assessment and financial modelling to support project-value optimisation.

Designed the 2027 OPEA AI Enablement and Scaling Concept, combining a four-level AI maturity model, six-phase methodology and targeted six-to-eight-week AI Value Waves with practical use-case implementation and evidence-based impact measurement; defined a scaling roadmap through 2029.

Designed and delivered business-specific, hands-on Copilot workshops and rapid-prototyping sessions, reaching 700+ colleagues with practical approaches to applying AI in business processes, including opportunities to create Copilot agents.

Established a cross-functional network of 28 AI Champions to support adoption through peer learning, reusable prompts and agents, use-case identification, and contributions to workshops and hackathons.

Co-organised and delivered a Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio hackathon in September 2026 with Microsoft, bringing together approximately 50 business participants across five groups to develop early prototypes, including a UK Control Room shift-handover agent workflow, with structured follow-up pathways.

Supported and guided business teams from ideation through creation and implementation of AI agents, including a Procurement Support Agent that compares market developments with internal procurement information and generates recommendations.
Led digital initiatives delivering high-value MVPs using Lean Startup, Design Thinking and Scrum.
Founded and led the Process Optimization Factory to automate repetitive processes, including Azure Document Intelligence for PDF data extraction.
Developed an Agile Innovation Framework for scouting and evaluating digital opportunities; provided agile coaching across business teams.
Provided strategy consulting in Digital & Mobile Commerce: couponing, location-based marketing, smart packaging, conversational commerce and AR.
Led mobile commerce projects in FMCG and retail; conducted market analysis and developed project concepts.
Managed international roll-outs of mobile services and apps using agile project management.
Drove product-management improvements across the app portfolio; evaluated business models and the competitive landscape.
